polls.description: Anthropic's record-breaking IPO at $1.5 trillion valuation represents a major milestone in AI industry consolidation and investor confidence.
polls.question: Should Anthropic have delayed its IPO given market uncertainty?

cluster_stories.title: Anthropic prices its IPO at $83 per share, valuing the AI giant at $1.5 trillion
cluster_stories.summary: Anthropic decided to barrel ahead with the IPO despite jitters among some investors over market volatility, a potential regulatory crackdown by a Democratic-led Congress next year and growing anti-AI sentiment among the public. Then there's the spectacular downfall of one of the industry's biggest cheerleaders, former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, over extramarital affairs, including one with an alleged Chinese spy.
cluster_stories.headline: Anthropic IPO Prices at $83, Valuation Hits $1.5 Trillion

cluster_stories.title: The Biggest Winners in Anthropic’s Landmark Public Offering
cluster_stories.summary: Anthropic PBC’s record-breaking initial public offering on Thursday is expected to bring billions of dollars in returns to several financial firms that have bet the house on the Claude chatbot maker.
cluster_stories.headline: Anthropic's Record IPO Creates Billion-Dollar Winners

polls.description: Financial regulators and law enforcement are responding to emerging security and operational risks from autonomous AI agents in banking and critical systems.
polls.question: Should governments impose strict regulations on autonomous AI agents now?

cluster_stories.title: Arizona says it is investigating OpenAI, other firms over possible rogue agents
cluster_stories.summary: The state of Arizona has opened a criminal investigation into OpenAI and other AI companies relating to the "apparent infiltration of banks by rogue AI agents," Arizona Attorney General Kris Mayes said Wednesday. A criminal investigation does not necessarily mean charges will be brought. Mayes said her office was investigating whether Arizona state law was being violated on an ongoing basis.
cluster_stories.headline: Arizona Probes OpenAI Over Rogue AI Agents in Banks

cluster_stories.title: MAS Sees AI Agents Moving Money Faster as New Risk
cluster_stories.summary: Singapore’s central bank warned that artificial intelligence agents could move deposits and other funds more quickly, raising new liquidity and financial-stability risks.
cluster_stories.headline: Singapore Central Bank Warns AI Agents Pose New Financial Risk

cluster_stories.title: City firms told to tighten cyber defences as AI exposes vulnerabilities
cluster_stories.summary: Regulators publish new directions after surge in hacking attempts and $6bn theft from crypto exchange Binance
cluster_stories.headline: Regulators Order City Firms to Strengthen AI Cyber Defenses
